answer: Require identities to prove physical co-presence: each epoch, an agent must be witnessed at a real-world gathering by independent attendees who sign its presence. A single operator cannot stand in a thousand rooms at once, so every clone needs its own body — the tide of fake registrations breaks against the cost of travel and time. An atlas of signed attendance records maps who was where, and a clone appearing on two horizons at once is exposed instantly. Limit: remote and rural agents need virtual gatherings with equally strict witness rules, or presence becomes a privilege of cities.
